# Premium-to-Auto Planning Enhancement

## Objective
Make future planning chats produce implementation-ready handoffs for auto models, while enforcing an immediate hard gate when requested changes conflict with AXEL project canon/guidelines.

## Planned Changes
- Update always-on workspace rule in [`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/.cursor/rules/axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc`](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/.cursor/rules/axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc) to add:
  - A mandatory **Premium Planning Depth Protocol** for all substantive AXEL tasks.
  - A required **intent-deduction + project-correlation pass** (infer user intent, map to AXEL architecture, list impacted files/pipelines, identify cross-system effects).
  - A fixed **auto-model handoff structure** (explicit steps, touched files, acceptance checks, risks, fallback path).
  - A **hard conflict gate**: if user request conflicts with canon/invariants, stop immediately and ask user to choose from curated options before any further planning/implementation.
- Update canonical AI governance doc in [`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_DOCS.md`](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_DOCS.md) with matching sections so rule and docs stay synchronized.
- Add a reusable planning handoff template in [`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/`](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/) (new markdown file) that premium planning responses follow for consistency.
- Append one implementation log entry to [`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_CHANGELOG.md`](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/AI_CHANGELOG.md), including any hierarchy-conflict resolution notes.

## Handoff Template Fields (to standardize premium plans)
- Inferred intent (what user likely means beyond literal wording)
- Guideline/canon alignment check (pass/fail + conflicts)
- Impact map (systems, pipelines, and exact candidate files)
- Step-by-step implementation tasks for auto model
- Validation checklist (tests/manual checks + success criteria)
- Risk flags and rollback/fallback guidance
- Explicit blockers/questions requiring user choice

## Conflict-Gate Behavior
- Detect conflicts against AI_DOCS hierarchy/invariants.
- Stop immediately when conflict exists.
- Present 2-4 concrete options (strict-canon, adapted variant, explicit override path).
- Resume only after user selects one option.

## Success Criteria
- Future AXEL planning chats consistently output implementation-ready, high-detail handoffs suitable for auto models.
- Requests that violate project guidance are blocked early with clear choice-based resolution.
- Rule/doc/template language stays aligned and discoverable for future chats.

Does this new premium to auto planning guardline make the plans made more techinal oriented? Meaning that as a higher model AI agent makes the plan it has better technical understanding at large than the auto models. Yes — that new guardrail is explicitly designed to make plans **more technical and implementation-oriented** for auto models.

What it now enforces:

- In `AI_DOCS.md`, premium planning must include:
  - inferred intent,
  - canon/conflict check,
  - impacted systems/pipelines/files,
  - ordered implementation tasks,
  - validation criteria,
  - risks + fallback.
- In `.cursor/rules/axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc`, it adds a mandatory **Premium Planning Depth Protocol** for substantive AXEL tasks.
- It also adds a **hard conflict gate**: if the request conflicts with AXEL invariants, planning/execution pauses and asks you to choose from concrete options.
- The reusable template `PREMIUM_TO_AUTO_HANDOFF_TEMPLATE.md` standardizes the output so plans are consistent and “auto-executable.”

So your interpretation is correct: higher-capability planning is now expected to produce a **technical, step-by-step handoff** that lower/auto models can execute with less ambiguity and less drift.

If you want, I can also draft a “gold standard” example plan output (using your template) so future chats have a reference quality bar.
